intro: Unwanted and Unworthy is a quest on Zephras where adventurers aid Elegael in retaliating against the Al'Aketh Cultists after a bloody ambush in Shadowgale Forest. By slaying the cultists and recovering stolen heirlooms, players avenge fallen druids and reclaim sacred ancestral relics for the High Elder.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Al'Aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.
These storm-cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I will make the cult pay for every drop of druid blood they have spilled this day.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Elegael looks down at the collection of bloodied heirlooms with distress.
So many young lives with so much potential now gone forever. Thank you for returning these, adventurer.
I will hold onto them for safekeeping until I am able to take them to the High Elder. There they can go back into the collection and await the next and perhaps more worthy generation to come of age.
